race.comment: Tricky race with so many first-starters. IRON STUPA (2) has also drawn poorly, but looks to have the best recent form of those who have raced. Just needs to hold that form. WOMBAT (3) is another returning from a spell and he's run some nice races in better maidens than this, so he warrants respect. HELLISH LEE (5) also resumes and is at her best over a little further than this, but as placed first up in the past so could pull out a run. MINTY (10) is a 3YO filly on debut for the Patrick Payne yard and has had six trials and jumpouts in readinesas for her debut effort. Drawn to get her chance for Beriman and she can play a leading role.
